engagement_context: Acme GBS retained to assess near-term BPO/shared-services opportunity with Helvetia Mittelstand AG, a EUR 1.2B Swiss industrial Mittelstand firm.

signals.evidence_snippet: Helvetia Mittelstand AG today opened a new Global Business Services centre in Katowice, consolidating finance and HR operations.
Company confirms multi-year S/4HANA migration programme across European entities.

hypotheses.statement: Active GBS buying intent now (BPO + ERP transformation underway).
hypotheses.would_change_mind: A public cancellation of the GBS centre or S/4HANA programme.
Evidence that the GBS centre is advisory-only with no managed services.

intent_assessment.recommended_action: Schedule discovery workshop with CFO office within 3 weeks; lead with S/4HANA-to-GBS operating-model play.

key_uncertainties: Deal size and incumbent BPO vendor unknown.
Whether GBS centre will insource or partner.

compliance_footer.scip_gdpr_statement: Collected public business info under SCIP Code of Ethics; GDPR Art.6(1)(f) legitimate interest, B2B public source.
